name: Rooms in a world file stream by distance
body: An entity with a `room` property and an engine-only kind (block, ramp, point_light, spot_light, no parent, no children) belongs to that room. lantern:::world:::StartStreaming and StreamRooms load rooms near any focus point and unload them past a larger distance, spending at most a budget of entities per frame, nearest first, and loading at once any room within the urgent distance. Meshes, colliders, lights and tags leave with the room.
